List four progressive policy initiatives that can be implemented to address income inequality. Exclude the words "tax" and "subsidy".  
1. Expand universal access to high-quality healthcare and education through publicly funded systems.  
2. Strengthen labor protections by enforcing living wages, portable benefits, and unionization rights.  
3. Invest in affordable housing infrastructure to prevent displacement and ensure stable living conditions.  
4. Implement comprehensive job training programs to bridge skills gaps and create pathways to higher-paying careers.
